title: OpenClaw setup catches up with v2026.3
summary:
OpenClaw setup caught up with v2026.3, website authorization gained a dedicated app key, and the README news rotated in newer community projects.

The Pollinations setup script now supports OpenClaw v2026.3 for fresh and existing installs without replacing other providers. It configures Kimi K2.5 by default, with DeepSeek V3.2 and GLM-4.7 as fallbacks; the README now lists all seven configured models.

The website’s Enter authorization redirect now passes a dedicated app key alongside its existing profile and balance permissions. The default key used for anonymous, rate-limited API calls is unchanged.

The README’s Latest News now features four March 18 entries covering community projects and showcase apps, replacing four older entries. This updates the news list, not the apps or API.
